info.title: Solana zkAPI USDC + Proxy
info.description: Implementation contract, not a deployed service. JSON amounts are decimal strings. Public control objects reject unknown fields; provider nested payloads require adapter validation.

post.description: Exact body retry only. First direct creation may contain provider_key; direct_oa also requires provider_key_verification for independent client verification. Neither field is replayed. Control token hash must match proof-bound authorization.

200.description: Idempotent existing result, no provider key or verification evidence

202.description: Proxy may become ACTIVE; direct closes delivery channel, persists close_requested and drains any late key.

post.description: Nullifier capability; atomic exclusion with AUTH reservation. Rate limited, no wallet identity.
